part.text:
Fixed in `hooks/src/index.js:333`.

The hooks `shouldComponentUpdate` bailout now also considers whether props changed (`p !== this.props`), so a component no longer skips a parent-initiated prop update just because its own state updates cancelled out on the same tick.

Validation:
- `hooks/test/browser/useState.test.js`: 13 passed, including `respects updates initiated from the parent`
- All hooks browser tests: 111 passed, 2 skipped
- Full karma suite: 1002 passed; 1 unrelated pre-existing environment failure in `events.test.js` (`focus` capture test under headless Chrome)
